archetype: Electric & Neon (Contextualized as 16-bit Minecraft Blocky Aesthetic)
global_rules: Must use only React Native components (View, Text, ScrollView, Image, TouchableOpacity, Pressable, TextInput, FlatList) and StyleSheet.
No HTML tags, no className, no Tailwind CSS.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` attribute.
Simulate pixel art borders by using thick, integer-based borders (e.g., borderWidth: 4) and hard edges (borderRadius: 0 or very small like 2).
To simulate a blocky 3D feel on buttons, use a thicker borderBottomWidth with a darker shade.
Use a monospace font family fallback (Platform.select({ ios: 'Menlo', android: 'monospace' })) and uppercase for headings to simulate retro pixel fonts.

hero.description: Seamless stone block texture. Use for global background or container backgrounds.

border.description: Dirt block texture with grass top edge. Use for dividers, tab bar backgrounds, or header borders.

mace_icon.description: Pixel art heavy mace weapon. Use as the main app logo, hero section icon, or in the loadout planner.

enchantment_icon.description: Glowing enchanted book. Use in the Enchantments guide section.

tier_icon.description: Diamond sword and armor. Use for the Tier List section or PvP tips.

layout_patterns.navigation: Bottom tab navigation with a dark stone background. Active tab uses an Emerald Green tint, inactive uses Stone Dark.
layout_patterns.screen_container: Use a dark background (#2c2c2c) or repeat the stone_texture image for the main View.
layout_patterns.list_items: Render list items as Cards with dirt-colored borders and stone backgrounds. Align text to the left.
layout_patterns.header: Custom headers utilizing dirt_grass_texture or dark stone with thick bottom borders.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a React Native Expo app.
Use purely React Native primitive components (`View`, `Text`, `Image`, `ScrollView`, `FlatList`, `TouchableOpacity`, `TextInput`).
Style completely with `StyleSheet.create`. DO NOT use Tailwind, NativeWind, HTML, or `className`.
Include a Bottom Tab Navigator using React Navigation to connect: Home, Guide, Loadout, Forum, Chat.
Implement the UI focusing on a blocky, 16-bit Minecraft aesthetic. Use thick borders (4px-8px) and no border radius to create sharp, pixel-like containers.
Use the provided image URLs via the `Image` component. For repeating textures like stone_texture, use `resizeMode='repeat'` if possible, or set it as a large background image.
Incorporate `testID` attributes on all buttons, tabs, input fields, and list items.
Populate the app with dummy data for the Mace mechanics guide, best enchantments (Density, Breach, Wind Burst), a basic Tier list, Loadout planner state, and a mockup of the AI chatbot screen.
